title: Equidimensional closed fibre of a finite type domain over a valuation ring
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring, meaning an integral domain such that for each nonzero $a\in K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ either $a\in A$ or $a^{-1}\in A$, and put $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$ for its residue field. Let $D$ be an integral domain containing $A$ as a subring and finite type as an $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Form the algebras $D_k=D\otimes_Ak$ and $D_K=D\otimes_AK$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with multiplication $(d\otimes a)(e\otimes b)=de\otimes ab$. If $D_k\ne0$, then $\dim D_k=\dim D_K$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and $\operatorname{Spec}D_k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is equidimensional: every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] equal to $\dim D_K$.
